posts.subject: 35hp_garden is unbalanced
posts.bodyHtml:
Hi Dream!


We have played 35hp_garden multiple times now and it seems that it's a bit unbalanced, the T's can get the Zeus and HE much faster, due to the distance they have to walk.
I would suggest to remove or re-balance this map.


- David.

Zeus?
I have never seen or known that there is a zeus on that map.

Hmmm, then again most maps would be "unbalanced" - for examples, Gladiators. I think the problem is the Zeus, having a Zeus in a knife server is simply useless, overpowered and unfair - maybe if you agree, you can remove then? @Nachtfrische


~Doo Doo

I agree, a Zeus kind of destroys the point of having a knife only map.
It will be removed soon.


Thanks for the suggestion.
